sentences.text:
In this petition, the petitioner is seeking initiation of contempt proceedings against the respondents for their willful disobedience and non-compliance of the judgment dated 05-04-2021 passed by this Court in OWP No. 1524/2012 titled as "Ghulam Hassan Khan & Anr. vs. State of JK &
Ors" whereby this Court while disposing of the petition has directed the District Development Commissioner, Baramulla to consider the claim of the petitioners in terms of procedure in vogue and pass the appropriate orders within a period of two months in accordance with law and rules governing the subject.

sentences.text:
2. On being put to notice, the respondents have filed statement of facts along with the Annexure R(I)
indicating therein that a decision has been taken in the Committee headed by the Deputy Commissioner, Baramulla to acquire the land of the petitioners by initiating acquisition proceedings under the J&K Land Acquisition Act, 1991 being an economical option.
This is apparent from the communication of the Deputy Commissioner, Baramulla dated 28.11.2023 appended with the statement of facts.

sentences.text: The statement of facts filed by the respondents came up for consideration before this Court on 12-02-2024 when learned Single Judge of this Court upon hearing the contempt petition found that compliance submitted by the respondents was not in consonance with law.
Three weeks time was granted to the respondents to file fresh compliance.

In compliance with the order dated 12-02-2024,
fresh compliance report has been filed by the Deputy Commissioner, Baramulla in which the respondents have again reiterated their earlier stand and have submitted that the Collector Land Acquisition (SDM, Uri) has already initiated a process for acquisition of the land in question by proceeding under Section 4 (1) of the J&K Land Acquisition Act, 1991 and further steps for implementation of the judgment passed by this court and to conclude the acquisition proceedings have been taken.

4. After hearing learned counsel for the parties and perusing the record, we are of the considered opinion that the compliance report dated 13-03-2024 filed in terms of order dated 12-02-2024 is again not in consonance with the judgment passed by the Hon'ble Division Bench whereby the respondents have been directed to follow the law in vogue.

Needless to say on the date judgment was passed i.e. on 05- 04-2021, the J&K Land Acquisition Act, 1991 stood repealed and was replaced by the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 ["Act of 2013"].
5.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 ["Act of 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: It is thus crystal clear that acquisition proceedings in the instant case are required to be initiated as per the new legislation and the compensation assessed, accordingly.

The plea of the respondents that they have resorted to the proceedings under the old Act for the reason that the said proceedings would be economical for the State/UT is a plea made in the despair and has no sanctity in law.
There seems to be a deliberate attempt to over reach the process of law and avoid compliance with the judgment passed by this Court.

6. We find it a fit case to frame Robkar and put the respondents, i.e., the Deputy Commissioner,
Baramulla, to show cause notice as to why the contempt proceedings are not initiated.

However,
with a view to providing one last opportunity, four weeks' time is granted to the Deputy Commissioner, Baramulla to initiate the acquisition proceedings in the instant case under the Act of 2013 without any further delay and report progress on the next date of hearing.

7. List on 9th August, 2024.
8.

We make it clear that in case needful is not done by the next date, the Deputy Commissioner,
Baramulla (Collector Land Acquisition) and Sub-Divisional Magistrate, Uri, shall appear in person before the Court on the next date of hearing.

(M. A. CHOWDHARY) (SANJEEV KUMAR)
 JUDGE JUDGE SRINAGAR 12.07.2024
